description.value: You made shoes for people who never thought about shoes until they needed them. The work was steady and unglamorous. A person's footwear says something about where they've been and where they're going, and after years of repairing and rebuilding, you read that language fluently.

system.skillBonuses: Craft: Cobbler 3, Society 3, Empathy 3, Investigate 3, +56 XP
system.startingEquipment:
Sewing kit
common clothes
low boots
system.features: Read the Road: You can examine footwear and determine meaningful information about its owner; things like their profession, approximate wealth, and recent travel conditions. When you examine tracks or worn shoes as part of an Investigate check, subtract 1 from one die result.
